title: Freddy Krueger! 🔥
description: He’s here to haunt your Minecraft nights… 🌙🔪
body:
He’s here to haunt your Minecraft nights… 🌙🔪


This **resource pack** transforms **The Man from the Fog** mod into the legendary **Freddy Krueger** from A Nightmare on Elm Street! 💀


🩸 **Features**:


🧠 Completely new **model, textures, and sounds**


🎞️ **Unique animations** inspired by Freddy’s eerie movements


🔊 **Original music and voice lines** straight from the Nightmare on Elm Street films


🌫️ A full horror atmosphere that brings Freddy’s nightmare to life in Minecraft


Sleep tight… because Freddy’s waiting. 😈



**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by M_Productions of Man from the Fog,
which replaces him with Freddy Krueger.
[https://www.curseforge.com/members/m_productions/projects](https://www.curseforge.com/members/m_productions/projects)


-Custom texture pack (x32)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Nightmare on Elm Street

-You need the [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-man-from-the-fog/files/5947084](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-man-from-the-fog/files/5947084)

-Also [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/7025129](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/7025129)
